description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crimson Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.
